import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String rs = scanner.nextLine();
        String s = rs.substring(1, rs.length() - 1);
        int length = s.length();
        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
        result.append(rs.charAt(0));
        int index = 0;
        boolean foundAt = false;
        while (index < length) {
            if (index + 3 <= length) {
                if (s.substring(index, index + 3).equals("dot")) {
                    result.append(".");
                    index += 3;
                    continue;
                }
            }
            if (index + 2 <= length && !foundAt) {
                if (s.substring(index, index + 2).equals("at")) {
                    result.append("@");
                    foundAt = true;
                    index += 2;
                    continue;
                }
            }
            result.append(s.charAt(index));
            index++;
        }
        result.append(rs.charAt(rs.length() - 1));
        System.out.println(result.toString());
        scanner.close();
    }
}
